name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
tagline: Native connector for a RuneScape: Dragonwilds Linux dedicated server.
requirements: Control of the Dragonwilds Linux dedicated server startup command

assets.label: Plugin (build 26161880) (current public build)
assets.requires: Dragonwilds Linux dedicated server, Steam build 26161880
assets.hint: Load with LD_PRELOAD on the game binary's launch line only; the plugin creates takaro.cfg next to the .so; the archive includes licenses and upgrade instructions.
